rooms.title: Room Zero
rooms.description: You are in an empty room. The walls are all gray and there are no windows or doors. The only light you see comes from a pillar in the center of the room. There is a small sign on the side of the pillar and a small piece of paper on the floor

rooms.title: Grassy Field Crossroads
rooms.subtitle: This is it. The world is yours.
rooms.description: You find yourself standing in the middle of a large, grassy field. The air is warm, and the sky above is bright blue. A sign stands nearby with a golden chest at its base. To the southwest, you see a small, cozy cabin. The peaceful atmosphere is filled with birdsong and the rustling of grass.

rooms.title: Grassy Field South
rooms.subtitle: Redberry Patch
rooms.description: The grass starts to get rocky in this area. A redberry bush is here, and consuming its fruit will restore lost health points. An entrance to a cave can be seen to the east, and a cabin is visible to the west.

rooms.title: Old Man
rooms.subtitle: Wood Cabin
rooms.description: The cabin is warm and cozy. A cooking fire burns here, and the Old Man is rocking in his chair. He insists that you make yourself at home and stay as long as you like, and encourages you to start and complete your first quests here.

rooms.title: Cabin Basement
rooms.description: The basement is waterlogged and dirty, with a putrid smell that permeates the air. There are rats here that can be attacked. To return to the cabin above, simply go back up the stairs.

rooms.title: Destroyed Basement
rooms.description: The basement is completely destroyed and waterlogged. There is rat crap everywhere. In between battles, you can rest to regain lost hit points or search the rubble for anything that may be useful.

rooms.title: Young Soldier
rooms.subtitle: Weapons Training
rooms.description: The training grounds are located on a cliff overlooking the ocean. Racks of weapons and armor stand ready for use, and a young soldier is here to guide you through your training. The breeze carries the fresh, salty sea air throughout the area.

rooms.title: Grassy Field West
rooms.subtitle: Flower Patch
rooms.description: A bright flower patch grows here. You see a cabin to the south and a beach to the west.

rooms.title: Grassy Field North
rooms.subtitle: Blueberry patch
rooms.description: Blueberry bushes grow in this part of the field. To the west you see a waterfall and to the east an odd tent. To the south you see the main crossroads.

rooms.title: Secret Arena
rooms.subtitle: Hope you\'re having a good time.
rooms.description: In a top secret fighting area. so cool. Here the developer can conjure up any enemy he wishes for battle testing. And what does this place look like? Whatever you want, use your imagination.

rooms.title: Grassy Field East
rooms.subtitle: Basic Shop
rooms.description: A Basic Shop is set up here where you can buy weapons, armor and other useful items. To the south is a cave and north is a strange tent. To the far east you see a forest.

rooms.title: Grassy Field Cave Entrance
rooms.description: In the Grassy Field at an entrance to a dark cave. There is a sign here.

rooms.title: Spider Cave Exit
rooms.description: Inside the spider cave. You can exit to the north or continue deeper into the cave by going south.

rooms.title: Spider Cave
rooms.description: Inside the spider cave.

rooms.title: Spider Cave
rooms.description: Standing in the darker part of the Cave. You see light from the entrance to the northwest. To the northeast you hear some vile sounds.

rooms.title: Spider Cave
rooms.description: Inside the spider cave.

rooms.title: Above the Scorpion Pit
rooms.description: An opening to a dark cave leads below. There is a warning sign here.

rooms.title: Scorpion Pit Entrance
rooms.description: Head up to the much safer Spider Cave. If you are feeling brave continue south through the Scorpion Pit.

rooms.title: Scorpion Pit Path
rooms.description: You continue through the dark scorpion lair.

rooms.title: Scorpion Control Room
rooms.description: This room is lighter than the others. There is a lever on the wall.

rooms.title: Scorpion Guard Room
rooms.description: Guards patrol this dark room.

rooms.title: Scorpion Hall
rooms.description: A very, very large room. Giant Scorpion tracks line the floor.

rooms.title: Scorpion Queen Nest
rooms.description: The vicious Scorpion Queen lives here. You have killed many of her children and she is not happy.

rooms.title: Scorpion Throne Room
rooms.description: You stand in an enormous throne room, a place few travelers have ever reached. This is the home of the King of All Scorpions. A weathered chest sits nearby.

rooms.title: Marsh Behind the Cabin
rooms.description: A gross swampy marsh. You see some gator tracks in the mud.

rooms.title: Dirt Road West
rooms.description: You are on a dirt path heading down to the beach.

rooms.title: On the Beach by a Giant Rock
rooms.description: The Sun is directly overhead and there is a cool breeze. You can mine stone from the giant rocks here.

rooms.title: Abandoned Docks On the Beach
rooms.description: You stand on a worn wooden dock. A vast blue ocean is to your west.

rooms.title: On the Beach
rooms.description: The Sun is directly overhead and there is a cool breeze. The waves slowly roll in.

rooms.title: On the Beach
rooms.description: The Sun is directly overhead and there is a cool breeze. The waves slowly roll in.

rooms.title: Sand Crab Nest
rooms.description: This part of the beach is swarming with Sand Crabs. They just won\'t stop! Teleport to the Grassy Field to escape here.

rooms.title: Healing Springs
rooms.subtitle: Mountain Waterfall
rooms.description: Relax in the warm waters that have formed here. Along your journey you will come across many waterfalls, lakes, fountains and other natural springs. Rest at these locations to supercharge your Health and Mana.

rooms.title: Pajama Shaman
rooms.subtitle: Shop & Skills
rooms.description: A hooded man has set up a strange tent here with a makeshift shop. He is selling some basic items and also teaching some important skills.

rooms.title: Dirt Road East
rooms.description: You are on a dirt path heading towards the forest. To the west you see the grassy field.

rooms.title: Jack\'s Forest Gate
rooms.description: A guard dressed in all red stands in front of the Forest Entrance. To the north you see a log cabin with a sign that reads "Free Trees".

rooms.title: Jack Lumber
rooms.subtitle: Professional Lumberjack
rooms.description: A flannel wearing, hatchet wielding man has a wood workshop set up here. He runs the tree farm to the north and has a few quests available. Completing his quests will open up the Forest.

rooms.title: Tree Farm
rooms.subtitle: Free Wood
rooms.description: Jack Lumber has a pretty nice tree farm here. Feel free to chop down some trees. Pick up a hatchet and have at it.

rooms.title: Stone Path South
rooms.description: On a stone path south of the grassy field.

rooms.title: Rocky Flats
rooms.subtitle: Gate to the
rooms.description: An armored dwarf guards the path to the Rocky Flats and the Mining Village. You see the bat cave to the west.

rooms.title: Bat Cave
rooms.subtitle: Entrance
rooms.description: The bat cave\'s concealed entrance is hidden beneath some jagged rock formations. Go below to enter the cave. There is a sign here warning of the dangerous creatures within.

rooms.title: Bat Cave
rooms.subtitle: Exit
rooms.description: A way out of the bat cave. To leave go up. To continue deeper into the bat cave go east.

rooms.title: Bat Cave
rooms.subtitle: Abandoned Workshop
rooms.description: A busted table and broken tools are thrown all across the room. You see a hammer on the floor that might be useful for crafting weapons and armor. Pick it up.

rooms.title: Bat Cave
rooms.description: In the bat cave.

rooms.title: Bat Nest
rooms.description: In the bat cave by the nest. Bats are flying all around the room.

rooms.title: Salamander Cavern
rooms.description: These magical salamanders mean business. Go west for goblins or south for bats.

rooms.title: Goblin Tracks
rooms.description: The bats don\'t dare fly to this part of the cave. You can put away your boomerang and use a melee weapon.

rooms.title: Goblin Dead End
rooms.description: You come to a dead end in the cave. You see goblins all around.

rooms.title: Goblin Chief Hideout
rooms.description: You find yourself in the Secret Goblin Hideout. The Goblin Chief lives here.

rooms.title: Destroyed Academy
rooms.subtitle: Grand Quest
rooms.description:
The shattered remains of a once majestic academy now stand, its crumbling walls revealing a labyrinth of broken archways, tattered banners, and fallen stone. Complete these grand quests to rebuild the Academy.

5 Quests-

10 Quests - Unlock Garden - Reddberry & Blueberry

20 Quests - Unlock Cow Farm

30 Quests - Unlock Jeweler

40 Quests - Unlock Blacksmith

You have completed

rooms.title: Friendly Giant - Mountain Shortcut
rooms.description:
An enormous smiling giant stands in front of the mountain path. He tells you every creature you encounter north of here is stronger than him, so if you want to pass you must beat him in friendly competition.

All enemies in the mountains are stronger than the Giant here, and no where near as friendly. Beat the giant in combat to take the shortcut north.

rooms.title: Forest Path
rooms.description: On a path through the Forest. Go west to return to the Grassy Field.

rooms.title: Forest Path near a Cow Farm
rooms.description: The path runs northwest to east here. Head north to visit Freddie's Cow Farm.

rooms.title: Freddie's Cow Farm
rooms.description: You want some leather? Freddie's got you covered.

rooms.title: Cows
rooms.description: Some cows

rooms.title: More Cows
rooms.description: Even more cows. There is also a pile of wood here.

rooms.title: On a Stone Path by a Forest Gate
rooms.description: A stone path runs north to south here. Head west to return back to the Grassy Field and northeast to enter the Forest. There is a sign here.

rooms.title: Traveling Wizard
rooms.subtitle: Basic Spells
rooms.description: A sleek looking wizard is resting here.

rooms.title: Traveling Warrior
rooms.subtitle: Warrior Skills
rooms.description:
A war weathered warrior is temporarily set up here teaching some fighting skills

A SLICE attack will increase the damage you do with One-handed weapons, and SMASH will increase Two-handed damage.

rooms.title: On a Stone Path by a Hill
rooms.description: 2 Red Guards stand here. To the north you see the traveling warrior and to the west a dirt path.

rooms.title: Dirt Path behind a Hill
rooms.description: The dirt path leads northwest. The Red Town Gate is east of here.

rooms.title: Behind a Hill by a Cave
rooms.description: You are on a dirt path. You see a cave entrance to the east.

rooms.title: Behind a Hill
rooms.description: At a dead end on a dirt path.

rooms.title: Ogre Lair Entrance
rooms.description: A cave entrance leads underground. There is a sign here.

rooms.title: Ogre Lair Exit
rooms.description: An exit in the cave.

rooms.title: Goblin Tent
rooms.description: A ratty tent is set up with a rat cooking over a fire. Goblin tracks run all across the dirt floor.

rooms.title: Rat's Nest
rooms.description: A filthy rat's nest. If you need some meat you can hunt here, otherwise get out because it stinks.

rooms.title: Hob Goblin Tent
rooms.description: A sturdy tent is set up here with assorted bows and arrows hanging from weapon racks. The goblins that live here seem a little more intelligent than the normal ones.

rooms.title: Ogre Path
rooms.description: You are on a wide path through the Ogre Lair. You see a map on the floor.

rooms.title: Orc Den
rooms.description: Violent crossbow wielding orcs live here.

rooms.title: Ogre Yard
rooms.description: At a large clearing in the cave.

rooms.title: Ogre Treasure Room
rooms.description: You see a black treasure chest in the center of this secret room.

rooms.title: Ogre Guard Room
rooms.description: Several guard posts line the eastern wall of the room. Impressive looking weapons hang on the wall.

rooms.title: Ogress Fire Altar
rooms.description: A pillar stands in the center of the room with a large flame shooting out. You hear grunts and chanting from within the shadows.

rooms.title: Ogre Lieutenant Quarters
rooms.description: The room here is dark and the floor is splattered with blood and goblin carcasses.

rooms.title: On a Stone Path
rooms.description: You continue on the path.

rooms.title: On a Stone Path
rooms.description: You continue on the path.

rooms.title: On a Stone Path by a Magical Gate
rooms.description:
A Red Guard stands watch at this magical glowing gate. To the southwest you see a cave entrance.

To go north you must be a member of the Wizard's Guild

To join the Wizard's Guild you must defeat the Kobold Master found in the cave to the southwest.

rooms.title: Kobold Lair Entrance
rooms.description: The cave entrance below is dark. There is a sign here.

rooms.title: Kobold Lair EXIT
rooms.description: At an exit in the Kobold Cave. Head up to safety.

rooms.title: Kobold Dead End
rooms.description: At a Dead End in the Kobold Lair. You see marks in the ceiling and walls that might indicate flying creatures. Have your boomerang, bow or crossbow ready on standby.

rooms.title: Kobold Twisted Path
rooms.description: The main path continues southeast. You hear chanting and drumming coming from the northwest.

rooms.title: Kobold Temple
rooms.description: An altar made out of bone stands in the center of the temple. It appears the kobolds sacrifice rats and other animals here.

rooms.title: Kobold Bloody Path
rooms.description: The path here is bloodier than usual. You hear a lot of grumbling and squealing to the east.

rooms.title: Kobold Hidden Chamber
rooms.description: A secret room in the lair. A gray chest sits against the far wall.

rooms.title: Kobold Dark Courtyard
rooms.description: In a large dark room. You hear many noises coming from the shadows.

rooms.title: Kobold Control Room
rooms.description: A dark corner of the Kobold Courtyard. You hear many noises coming from the shadows. A lever is mounted to the wall here.

rooms.title: Kobold Magic Altar
rooms.description: A Glowing Magical Altar stands in this corner of the Courtyard. Warlocks can be heard chanting in the shadows.

rooms.title: Kobold Champion Arena
rooms.description: The floor here is paved flat. You see huge bloody footprints and pieces of weaker kobolds all over the floor.

rooms.title: Kobold Master Chambers
rooms.description: The room here is oddly clean. There are lit candles everywhere and unique weapons are mounted on the walls.

rooms.title: Forest Entrance
rooms.description: A way out of the forest. Go southwest to return to the stone path. Go any other direction to venture deeper into the forest.

rooms.title: Under a Massive Tree in the Forest
rooms.description: An enormous tree and its canopy encompass all you see overhead. You see some animal skins scattered on the ground.

rooms.title: Hunter Bill
rooms.subtitle: Hunter Skills
rooms.description: You see Bill crafting some arrows while tending to a fire. You can rest up here or learn some new hunting skills. He also has some quests available.

rooms.title: In the Forest by a Gold Chest
rooms.description: A river is running through the area here and you see a campfire to the southwest. A large, shiny golden chest sits in the grass. There is a sign here.

rooms.title: In the Forest by a River
rooms.description: A river runs south here. to the west you see a campfire and to the south you see a glowing teleport. A gold chest can be seen to the north. You see a shiny green ring on the ground.

rooms.title: Forest Clearing
rooms.description: Paths go off in all directions. There is a directory here.

rooms.title: In the Forest by a Fork in the Road
rooms.description: You are on the main path that connects the north part of the Forest with the south. The Forest exit is to the west.

rooms.title: In the Forest on a Beaten Path
rooms.description: You are on a worn Forest Path. You see a Red Tower peeking through the tree tops to the south and a graveyard to the southeast. Head northwest to exit the Forest.

rooms.title: In the Forest by a Red Guard Tower
rooms.description: Red Town lies to the south and a small graveyard to the east. Most of the Forest lies to your north. You see a bundle of arrows resting against the tower.

rooms.title: In the Forest by a Small Graveyard
rooms.description: A handful of makeshift gravestones are placed here. This area of the Forest seems darker than the rest. There are some redberry bushes scattered around.

rooms.title: In the Forest by a Cliff
rooms.description: You can walk to the edge of this cliff and overlook a vast desert to your east. To the north you see a very dense area of the Forest.

rooms.title: In the Forest Surrounded by Trees
rooms.description: So many trees here. To the southwest you see a small graveyard and to the west you see a tree hut.

rooms.title: Forest Gnome
rooms.subtitle: Tree Hut
rooms.description: A tiny gnome has a cozy tree hut set up here. He has a set of quests available for you and a free hatchet if you need one.

rooms.title: Forest Dead End
rooms.description: The forest path ends here. There are some blueberry bushes scattered around.

rooms.title: Abandoned Campsite
rooms.description: There is a vacant firepit and campground set up here next to the river. It looks like there was an animal attack and whoever was here, decided to leave. There are some redberry bushes here. Head back west to the Forest Clearing.

rooms.title: In the Forest by a Lake
rooms.description: The river flows into a lake here. Head NW to return back to the Forest Clearing or east along a rocky Forest Path.

rooms.title: In the Forest on a Rocky Path
rooms.description: The path veers west to north here. The path north seems to be a little darker.

rooms.title: In the Forest on a Twisted Path
rooms.description: The path is getting darker and more treacherous as you head north.

rooms.title: In the Forest approaching Troll Territory
rooms.description: The Forest gets very dark to the north. You hear grunting and squealing coming from that direction as well. A hill stands to your west. Head back south to return to a safer part of the forest.

rooms.title: In the Forest atop a Hill
rooms.description: You stand on top of a hill in the Forest. You think you can jump over the river to west if you time it correctly.

rooms.title: Adandoned Troll Guard Post
rooms.description: The Forest is getting very dark here. You see a Troll Camp to the west. Head south if you want to return to a safer part of the Forest.

rooms.title: Troll Base Camp
rooms.description:
Guard Posts are set up here in the darkest part of the Forest. You hear Trolls rustling behind the trees all around you.

Trolls are quite strong. They have a power attack that can do up to 3 times damage!

rooms.title: On a Path to Red Town by a Forest Gate
rooms.description: To the north you see a forest path and to the far south you see the Red Town Gates.

rooms.title: On a Stone Path by Red Town
rooms.description: Continue southwest to Red Town. North to the forest.

rooms.title: On a Stone Path by a Farm
rooms.description: A cabin and farm can be seen to the west. You see a big red gate to the south.

rooms.title: Red Town Grand Gate
rooms.description: Four Red Guards stand watch over the massive open doors of the Red Gate. Head east to get to the Grand Square and everything else Red Town has to offer. To the west you see a large stone gate.

rooms.title: Rocky Flats Gate
rooms.description: A dwarf guard blocks the entrance to the Rocky Flats Map.

rooms.title: Iron Altar
rooms.description: A massive iron structure is assembled here. 10 iron pillars are arranged in a circular formation. At the back of the altar is an empty iron chest with a sign next to it.

rooms.title: Broccoli Rob's Veggie Stand
rooms.description: Rob has a well built food stand set up here with all sorts of fruits and veggies for sale.

rooms.title: Rob's Farm
rooms.description: Rows and rows of fruits and veggies are growing here.

rooms.title: Red Town Grand Path
rooms.description: The main road heading to the Grand Square is very busy. There is also a stall here with free Red Town maps. Head back west to exit town.

rooms.title: Red Town
rooms.subtitle: Grand Square
rooms.description: The heart of New Babylon. This is easily the busiest area in town. There is a bubbling fountain here as well as a crafting table and fire.

rooms.title: Red Town Warrior's Way
rooms.description: On a path north of the Grand Square. Continue north to visit the Red Guard Barracks.

rooms.title: Red Guard Barracks
rooms.description: In the large main room for the Red Guard. Head north to the living quarters or northeast to go through the captain's office to the forest lookout tower. There are some free weapons here.

rooms.title: Red Guard Living Quarters
rooms.description: Beds and dressers line the walls here. Men are seen sleeping, eating or preparing for their work shift. Some are even playing cards. There is a table here with some cooked meat that's up for grabs.

rooms.title: Red Guard Captain's Office
rooms.description: This office is empty, no one is around. Head southwest to exit the Barracks, or north to visit the Captain at the Lookout Tower.

rooms.title: Red Guard Captain - Forest Lookout
rooms.description: Standing on the Lookout Tower you see most of the Forest below. Large areas of trees are divided by natural dirt paths. A tree hut is clearly visible as well. The Red Guard Captain has some quests for you.

rooms.title: Adam's General Store
rooms.description: Adam has a neat and tidy shop set up here.

rooms.title: Red Town Royal Road
rooms.description: You are on a pristine road connecting Town Hall with the Shops and Guilds to the west.

rooms.title: Red Town Courtyard
rooms.description: Many people are bustling through the courtyard. Paths come and go in all directions. There is a sign here as well as an entrance to the sewers below.

rooms.title: Red Town Church
rooms.description: The church is empty. There is nothing to do here now.

rooms.title: Todd's Pub & Inn
rooms.description:
All sorts of bubbling vials and beakers are set up here. Before any long journey make sure you stock up with plenty of healing potions and other useful consumables.

Todd's is where travelers and townsfolk gather to swap stories over ale and laughter. The beds are cozy, and the company is always lively.

rooms.title: Town Hall Plaza
rooms.description: The Red Town Plaza has many benches and tables set up for its citizens. People are mingling and taking care of business. Some are looking for help and offering rewards.

rooms.title: Mayor Rudolf
rooms.subtitle: Town Hall Office
rooms.description: Most important business for Red Town is handled in this room. The Mayor is sitting down at his desk going through some paper work. He has a big quest available for you if you are up for the challenge.

rooms.title: Town Hall Royal Courtyard
rooms.description: A large lavish courtyard is lined with benches to relax. Potted plants are placed everywhere. You see the gardens to the west and the dining room to the north. The Mayor can be reached upstairs.

rooms.title: Red Dining Room
rooms.description: A table that can easily sit over 20 is in the center of this very large room. Fancy glass cabinets filled with fine china and silverware line the walls. Some food stuffs are available for you to take.

rooms.title: Babylon Gardens
rooms.description: A perfectly manicured garden is displayed here. All sorts of flowers and bushes are growing, including thick vines climbing the trellises above, creating a lush green shelter with a gold chest in its center.

rooms.title: Wizard's Guild
rooms.description: Many men and women in robes are standing around the entrance to the Wizards Guild, mingling about magic and potions. There is a sign next to an impressive display of shiny wizard items.

rooms.title: Guild Exit
rooms.subtitle: Wizard's Guild
rooms.description: At the Wizard's main exit. Go southeast to get wizard spells, skills, items and quests. Head down to return back to town.

rooms.title: Main Lobby
rooms.subtitle: Wizard's Guild
rooms.description: Many spell casters are seen mingling in this very large room. There are tables with food and drink, and a fire is lit in the corner. Grab some free food or potions off the tables. There is a directory here to help you navigate around the guild.

rooms.title: General Store
rooms.subtitle: Wizard's Guild
rooms.description: Some great wizard items are for sale here. Stock up on blue potions and some stronger staffs before you venture out.

rooms.title: Guildmaster's Office
rooms.subtitle: Wizard's Guild
rooms.description: Grandmaster Quinn has a neat and tidy office with all sorts of magical doohickeys laying about. He has a bowl on his desk with a bunch of mana regen rings. // ELITE QUESTS Coming Soon!

rooms.title: Skills and Spells
rooms.subtitle: Wizard's Guild
rooms.description:
You can now learn a whole slew of new powerful spells. Spend your SP wisely to become a master spell caster.

ATOMIC BLAST is a super powerful spell, but uses alot of MP

rooms.title: Jeweler
rooms.subtitle: Wizard's Guild
rooms.description: The Jeweler is adorned with all sorts of fancy rings and amulets. He has some popular Wizard Only rings available for purchase.

rooms.title: Morty's Quest Set
rooms.subtitle: Wizard's Guild
rooms.description: The comedic wizard Morty has several quests available for you. Complete these 3 quests to become one of the strongest Wizards known.

rooms.title: Xavier's Quest Set
rooms.subtitle: Wizard's Guild
rooms.description: Xavier will have the most elite of Guild Quests. Soon...

rooms.title: Warrior's Guild
rooms.description: Many sword and axe wielding warriors congregate here in front of a massive stone building. Sword and shield banners hang along the walls. There is a sign here next to some impressive looking weapons.

rooms.title: Warrior's Guild EXIT
rooms.description: Head down to exit the Guild. Go North for Weapons and Armor. Go West for Skills. Head NW to access the Grand Mess Hall and Warrior Quests.

rooms.title: Warrior's Weapon & Armor Shop
rooms.description: Rows and rows of shiny weapons and armor are on display in this Shop. Upgrade your weapons to gain the edge in battle.

rooms.title: Warrior Skills
rooms.subtitle: Warrior's Guild
rooms.description:
Here you can further your combat training. Increase your fighting and defensive skills!

MAGIC STRIKE will add some extra magic damage to your melee attacks! BLOCK will increase the amount of damage you deflect with a shield!

rooms.title: Warrior's Grand Hall
rooms.subtitle: Warrior's Guild
rooms.description: Many seasoned warriors congregate here trading war stories while eating chickens whole. Rows of tables with hearty food is available for all members. A fire roars in the corner where you can cook up some meat if you so desire. Resting here also super charges your HP.

rooms.title: Warrior Pete's Quests
rooms.subtitle: Warrior's Guild
rooms.description: Pete is an accomplished warrior. You see him skillfully juggling some swords. He also has 3 quests available for you.

rooms.title: Warrior William's Quest Set
rooms.description: Willy will have 3 quests available for you soon. Meanwhile go do something else productive.

rooms.title: Michael's Weapon Shop
rooms.description: Michael has a fully functional weapons distribution business set up here. Time to upgrade your weapon if you have the coin.

rooms.title: Wizards Way
rooms.description: On a path heading to the southern part of town. You can reach the south gate as well as Vincenzo's Meat & Produce Stand. The road splits to the southeast into a dark alley.

rooms.title: Vincenzo's Meat & Produce Stand
rooms.description: Chatty Vinny has a wooden stand set up here with some home-grown meat and produce for sale. There are chickens running all around you.

rooms.title: Red Town South Gate
rooms.description: The South Gate is currently locked down by the Red Guard. The southern Plains have creatures that you could not possibly survive against. To the west you see a giddy bearded man waving to grab your attention.

rooms.title: Red Town Back Alley
rooms.description: A shady looking alley continues east here. Head back northwest to the safer part of town.

rooms.title: Back Alley by a Sewer
rooms.description: A sewer entrance is here with the cap removed. You can head down if you want, but be prepared to somewhat dangerous, but mostly smelly, enemies. There are some strange looking banners hanging on the building walls here as well.

rooms.title: South Sewer EXIT
rooms.description: A way out of this dark and smelly sewer. Head up to return to the back alley or explore what this awful place might have to offer.

rooms.title: By a Large Curved Pipe in the Sewer
rooms.description: The sewer curves here along the path of a huge pipe.

rooms.title: North Sewer EXIT
rooms.description: Head up to exit the sewer and reach the Royal Courtyard.

rooms.title: A Fork in the Sewer
rooms.description: The filthy sewer path splits here.

rooms.title: Sewer Crossroads
rooms.description: Many paths intersect here. And every path is covered with crap.

rooms.title: In the Sewer near the exit
rooms.description: Head east to reach the exit of this awful place or west to go deeper into the garbage.

rooms.title: In the Sewer by a Smelly "Pond"
rooms.description: The pond is made mostly of poop, incase you didn't pick up on that.

rooms.title: Crossing the Sewer Path
rooms.description: The sewer opens up here. Two wide paths intersect here.

rooms.title: In the Sewer by a "Waterfall"
rooms.description: This is not the type of waterfall you want to splash around in.

rooms.title: In the Sewer by the Catacombs
rooms.description: You get an uneasy feeling here. There is a massive stone wall to your north. You can reach the rest of the sewer by heading south.

rooms.title: It's Pitch Black in the Sewer
rooms.description: You can barely see a thing. You stumble over dead animals, trash and of course, shit. You hear some muffled screaming coming from the north.

rooms.title: At a Dead End in the Sewers
rooms.description: You reached a dead end in the sewers and there's nothing you can do about it. Just give up now.

rooms.title: Thieve's Den Hangout
rooms.description: Chairs and tables are set up here for card games and eating. Stolen merchandise seems to be all over the place. You see a stash of crossbow bolts in the corner of the room.

rooms.title: Thieve’s Den Secret Entrance
rooms.description: You managed to find a secret entrance to the Thieve's Den. Head down to make your way to the Thieve's Treasure Room.

rooms.title: Thieve's Den Training Room
rooms.description: This heavily fortified training room is used quite often by Brute Thieves. Be wary.

rooms.title: Thieve's Den Treasure Room
rooms.description: This room is littered with gold, treasures and other shiny things. There is a large chest here as well.

rooms.title: The Catacombs EXIT
rooms.description: A massive stone door is to your southwest. The Catacombs extend very far towards the west. You see some burnt books on the ground and several skulls embedded in the stone walls.

rooms.title: The Catacombs Library
rooms.description: Destroyed bookshelves are littered all across this room. Charred books cover the floor. You see the Catacombs Exit to the south and a very shiny walkway to the east. Head west to go deeper into the catacombs.

rooms.title: The Catacombs Gallery
rooms.description: Faded paintings and murals cover the walls in the gallery. There are shattered bone pieces piled up in the corners.

rooms.title: The Catacombs Armory
rooms.description: Several skeletons are standing upright in this room. Some are still wearing armor but most of their weapons and equipment are scattered along the floor.

rooms.title: The Catacombs Torture Chamber
rooms.description: Various torture devices line the bloody walls of this room.

rooms.title: The Catacombs Room of Skulls
rooms.description: Hundreds of skulls are placed into little cubbies along every wall in this room. Candles are lit in every eye socket.

rooms.title: The Catacombs Sacred Altar
rooms.description: Elaborate skull pillars are arranged in a circular fashion around a bone altar. There is a bowl of what can only be assumed is holy water in the center of the altar.

rooms.title: The Catacombs Sacrificial Chamber
rooms.description: A blood soaked stone table is covered with several ornamental daggers of various shapes and sizes. Every single wall, floor and ceiling surface in this chamber is made entirely of bone.

rooms.title: A Sewer Oasis
rooms.description: You have found the only safe haven in the sewers. Rest up here before you head back out into the stink.

rooms.title: Across a Sewer River by a Gray Chest
rooms.description: The secret sewer alcove here has a shiny gray chest. There are also some potions to pick up!

rooms.title: Silver Vault
rooms.description: A silver chest stands in the center of this shimmering room.

rooms.title: Turn in the Back Alley
rooms.description: A dark corner in the alley. You don't know what is lurking in the shadows nor do you want to.

rooms.title: Back Alley Apartments
rooms.description: Some less than desireable apartments make up the majority of the back alley here. Go back north to the safer part of town.

rooms.title: Red Town Docks
rooms.description: You get a whiff of salty air here. The Sea to the East contains creatures that are currently too strong for you to deal with. [ DOCKS CURRENTLY CLOSED ]

rooms.title: Shady Shop
rooms.description: A shady looking character has a shady shop set up here. Shady, i know. He has some weapons, consumables and ammunition available at discounted prices.

rooms.title: Red Town Stables
rooms.description: A large selection of horses and other strong mounts are available for purchase here, if you have the coin.

rooms.title: On a Stone Path near Red Town
rooms.description: To the east you see the Grand Red Gates approaching New Babylon (a.k.a. Red Town). To the west you can access the rest of the Rocky Flats map.

rooms.title: On a Stone Path
rooms.description: Head northwest for the Rocky Flats Crossroads. Head east to return to Red Town.

rooms.title: Rocky Flats Crossroads - Dwarf Captain
rooms.description: The Dwarven Captain stands guard here, enforcing the law for the area. He has 3 quests available for you. There is a map directory here as well.

rooms.title: On a Stone Path
rooms.description: Head north to get to the Grassy Field or southeast for the Rocky Flats Crossroads.

rooms.title: On a Stone Path near the Grassy Field
rooms.description: Head north to get to the Grassy Field (and Blue Ocean) or go south for the rest of the Rocky Flats Map.

rooms.title: Rocky Flats Ledge
rooms.description: From this rocky ledge south of the village, one can get a good view of the stone path below. It is also a good place to rest and gather supplies for adventurers.

rooms.title: Dwarf Village Square
rooms.description: The common area of the Mining Village is a hub of activity. To the north, you will find a shiny shop that is sure to catch your eye, while a pathway marked "Dwarf Treasury" leads to the northwest. To the east, you can find the Mining Guild. To the southwest, you will find the exit from the village. In the center of the area, there is a coal fire burning where you can rest and warm up after a long day of mining. Near the fire, there is a Bounty Board.

rooms.title: Mining Guild
rooms.description: The blacksmith forge in the Mining Guild burns nonstop, with dwarves bustling all around the area. A strange-looking dwarf has set up a shop nearby, where you can find a perfectly organized display of brand new pickaxes and hammers. To the north, you can find the entrance to the Neverending Mine. The Guild is a busy and lively place, filled with the sound of hammering and the glow of the forge.

rooms.title: Mining Guild FORGE
rooms.description: A blacksmith forge burns non stop here. This large well lit room easily has the most guild members in it, all taking turns creating armor and weapons. Feel free to craft items or rest here. There is also a Guild Directory.

rooms.title: Mining Guild EXIT
rooms.description: You've made it to the Mining Guild! Here you will learn how to craft strong equipment out of Iron, Steel and Mithril by digging down to new depths over at the mine. To get there go northeast from the FORGE, which is west of here. Head up to exit the Guild and reach the Dwarf Village.

rooms.title: Mining Guild Headquarters
rooms.subtitle: Guild Leader
rooms.description: This room is business central for the guild, you see many upper level miners discussing rocks and such. The Guild Leader stands behind a desk near the far wall.

rooms.title: Mining Guild Supply Shop
rooms.description: A strange looking dwarf has a shop set up here. There are buckets of tools and long racks of stones all over the place. In the midst of all the junk is a perfectly organized display of brand new pickaxes and hammers. iron, steel and mithril, all for sale.

rooms.title: The Sentinel Room
rooms.description: A massive fighting arena surrounded by walls of smooth stone.

rooms.title: Dwarf Treasury
rooms.description: The Treasury is decorated very nicely with rare metals and jewels embedded in the furniture, walls and ceiling. There is a shimmering steel display here with a Gold and Silver Chest. If you have any keys, please help yourself.

rooms.title: Silver Shop
rooms.description: A fancy looking dwarf is decked out in full silver gear and has a shop set up offering the same silver weapons and armor for you. If you can afford it.

rooms.title: The Neverending Mine - Base Camp
rooms.description: You stand atop the Neverending mine owned by the Mining Guild. Several miners are seen here preparing for future expeditions. Head on down to enter level 1 of the Mine. If you don't have access yet complete the Mining Guild quest to the south. There are also some free mining supplies here and a fire to rest at.

rooms.title: Mine Level 0
rooms.description: This place is Mine Room Zero, the big M00. Your trecherous journey below begins here. There is absolute no danger in this room, as well as no ore. If you want some, you're gonna have to grab a pickaxe and start digging.

rooms.title: Mine Level 1
rooms.description: You are in the neverending mine. You can mine down another level or mine here some more.

rooms.title: Mine Level 30 - Minotaur
rooms.description: You are in the neverending mine. You can mine down another level or mine here some more.

rooms.title: On a Muddy Path by the Crossroads
rooms.description: The path west starts to get muddy here. To the east you see the Dwarf Captain standing guard.

rooms.title: On a Muddy Path
rooms.description: That's pretty much it. It's muddy.

rooms.title: On a Muddy Path by an Abandoned Mine
rooms.description: The path continues northwest towards the Swamp. Another path splits off sharply to the northeast heading up a hill to the Abandoned Mine.

rooms.title: Abandoned Mine ENTRANCE
rooms.description: The entrance to the mine is a mess. There are broken tools and stone scattered everywhere. There is a sign here.

rooms.title: Abandoned Mine EXIT
rooms.description: A way out of the Abandoned Mine. Head up to exit or southeast to travel deeper into the condemned mine.

rooms.title: Bloody Skeever Tracks
rooms.description: Large rodent tracks go every which way in this room.

rooms.title: Bleeding Nests
rooms.description: Slimy, bloody nests are found all over this room. You hear buzzing and screeching all around you.

rooms.title: Lair of the Worm
rooms.description: This room is almost completely covered in a slimy mucus, and it smells… bad. Watch out for the giant, poisonous boss worm here.

rooms.title: On a Muddy Path approaching a Swamp
rooms.description: A Blue Guard stands here blocking the path to the Swamp. If you wish to gain access to the Swamp Path you must open the Gold Chest in the Dwarf Mining Village. Otherwise head back southeast.

rooms.title: Dry Grass Clearing
rooms.description: You are at a junction of paths. To the north you see the Dwarf Guard Captain. To the southeast you see a massive arena and to the south there is a locked gate. The path continues to the southwest.

rooms.title: On a Grass Path near a Fortress
rooms.description: You see a massive Red Fort to the west. The grass path continues northeast and south.

rooms.title: On a Grass Path near the Grotto
rooms.description: An intricately carved stone door blocks the Grotto Entrance to the southwest. You have a feeling a lever in the nearby Fort might open it. The grass path continues north and south.

rooms.title: On a Grass Path Approaching the Savannah
rooms.description: A Gray Guard blocks the Savannah entrance here. He remains silent as you try to look past him. To exit head back north.

rooms.title: Stone Grotto
rooms.description: This stone cave has many lush trees and bushes growing in its natural running water. There is a small pond here surrounded by intricately carved dwarven statues. The statues have a variety of small birds and glowing dragonflies buzzing around them. Behind one of the statues you see a wide spiral staircase made of stone and covered with moss. The staircase descends under the ground.

rooms.title: Under the Grotto
rooms.description: Even more bushes and colorful flowers grow here beneath the roots. There is a big echo in this chamber and you hear odd noises coming from all around you. There are the same statues down here that are above. The statues all have their hands open ready to receive an offering. You see a strange pair of light blue gloves in the hands of one of the statues.

rooms.title: Red Fort Courtyard
rooms.description: A nicely groomed lawn is here with little patches of bushes and flower. Try not to mess any of them up fighting the bandits. The path continues west into the Red Fort.

rooms.title: Red Fort Hallway
rooms.description: This large decorated hallway leads deeper into the Fort.

rooms.title: Red Fort Barracks
rooms.description: Swords, axes, and armor for Red Beard's bandits are stored in this room. Might be useful to search for equipment here. You also smell some good cooking to the south.

rooms.title: Red Fort Kitchen
rooms.description: The infamous Red Fort Kitchen. Many great meals have been prepared here for the Red Bandits. Watch out for the Butcher though. He has a reputation for having a mean streak.

rooms.title: Red Beard's War Room
rooms.description: A large oak table has a big map of the surrounding area with red markers to represent the bandits' location as well as all the opposing guards who watch over the land. This is where Red Beard can usually be found. Be cautious though, he packs quite a punch.

rooms.title: Empty Arena
rooms.description: In the empty arena of the Rocky Flats, you stand alone on the broken stone floor. The flat and barren ground stretches out around you, devoid of any vegetation or other features. The air is still and quiet, with only the gentle breeze blowing through the rocky hills providing any sound.

rooms.title: Silver Mine
rooms.description: The silver mine is below. Awesome.

rooms.title: In the Ocean near the Docks
rooms.description: The ocean's waves slowly roll in. The natural water current here wants to take you to the southwest. To the northwest is a smaller but calmer part of the ocean. Go east to return to the Grassy Field.

rooms.title: Quiet in the Ocean
rooms.description: The waves calm down here and the ocean is very pleasant. A nice breeze is rolling off the mountains to the northeast. You think you might even be able to go under the water here.

rooms.title: In the Waves by the Beach
rooms.description: The waves are somewhat choppy here. Head west to reach the rest of the ocean or east for the beach and grassy field.

rooms.title: Cruising Along a Beachside Current
rooms.description: A swirling current breaks off in many directions here. Far to the east you see a beach and to the south you see a large yellow temple. Go west to get to the rest of the ocean.

rooms.title: Yellow Water Temple
rooms.description:
You are in the middle of an enormous golden temple. There is water flowing from the walls and little fish jumping in and out of it.

The Heavy Walrus has insanely high Defense. You will need some big hits to defeat it.

rooms.title: Blue Ocean Crossing
rooms.description: The vast ocean is quite beautiful here. You can go off in any direction. You see a storm brewing far to the north. The Yellow Water Temple lies to the east. A muddy island can be found to the south and more ocean lies to the west.

rooms.title: Storm to the North
rooms.description: You can go north, but be cautious, there is a massive storm forming. You can go around the storm if you go northwest. Head back south for the rest of the ocean.

rooms.title: Traveling Along a Jetty
rooms.description: A fast moving jetty is traveling around the storm. You see a giant Blue Temple to the northeast. Head back southeast to get to the rest of the ocean.

rooms.title: Blue Water Temple
rooms.description:
You are in the middle of an enormous sapphire temple. There is electrically charged water flowing down the walls as well as bluefish jumping in and out of the water around you.

To summon the Blue Water Temple Boss, simply attack! Be prepared though, the Coral Wizard hits strong with magic.

rooms.title: In the Ocean trapped under the Storm
rooms.description: Dark clouds churn above you. You are surrounded by thunder and lightening and unable to find your way out of the storm. Head down under the ocean if you can, or teleport out of here to safety.

rooms.title: In the Ocean near Mud Island
rooms.description: You see a muddy island to the southeast. The rest of the ocean is to the north and west.

rooms.title: Mud Island
rooms.description: Your cool boots are now covered with mud. There is a cave entrance here leading below.

rooms.title: Blue Oasis - Friendly Pirate
rooms.description: You stand on a beautiful island oasis. There are lush palm trees and vibrant berry bushes all around as well as a natural fresh water spring here where you can rest. A friendly pirate is here with some quests.

rooms.title: In the Ocean
rooms.description: You are in the middle of the ocean. To the north you see a beautiful Island Oasis. To the far east you see a yellow temple and south is more ocean.

rooms.title: Ocean Calm
rooms.description: The waves have calmed down in this part of the Ocean. To the west you see a Green Temple and to the east you see a Muddy Island. Head south to the Swamp and northeast for more Ocean.

rooms.title: On the Ocean by the Swamp Entrance
rooms.description: Head south to leave the Ocean and enter the Swamp. To the northwest is the Green Temple and to the west you see a whirlpool.

rooms.title: A Secret Way Under the Sea
rooms.description: A giant whirlpool here draws the surface water below. You can go under the Ocean here if you are breathing water, or head north for the Green Temple, or east for the Swamp Entrance.

rooms.title: Green Water Temple
rooms.description:
You are in the middle of an enormous emerald temple. There are long leafy vines growing all around the walls.

To summon the Green Water Temple Boss, simply attack! Be prepared though, the Smooth Ranger attacks with a powerful bow and can also heal.

rooms.title: Trapped in a Swirling Current
rooms.description: You find yourself stuck in a swirling current. The only way you can escape is by heading back west.

rooms.title: Near an Oasis
rooms.description: You see a beautiful island oasis to the east. You see a series of tornadoes forming to the southwest. It looks like you can also go underwater here.

rooms.title: Riding a Massive Wave
rooms.description: All the currents of the ocean lead here to create the gnarliest wave you've ever seen. Be careful though, this area is easily the most dangerous place in the whole ocean. Surfs up.

rooms.title: In a Tornado of Currents
rooms.description: The never-ending cycle of tornadoes here makes the area very dangerous. On top of the weather conditions you need to watch out for vicious crocodiles! Head west for the Red Water Temple and southeast for the Green Water Temple. You see a lush green island to the southwest.

rooms.title: Red Water Temple
rooms.description:
You are in the middle of an enormous ruby temple. You see rivers of flames flowing out of the walls.

To summon the Red Water Temple Boss, simply attack! Be prepared though, the Thunder Barbarian can hit hard with POWER and CRITICAL attacks!

rooms.title: Crocodile Island - Jungle Jim
rooms.description: The island here is covered with lush trees and bushes and is very humid. Jungle Jim has a simple Tree Hut set up here and has some quests available for you. O and watch out for Crocs.

rooms.title: Master Temple
rooms.subtitle: Water Temple Guardian
rooms.description: You stand on the main platform of the Master Water Temple. You can reach any of the 4 Water Temples from this location. The powerful Water Temple Guardian stands watch here as well.

rooms.title: Poseidon's Temple
rooms.description: You are flying miles high in Poseidon's Grand Temple. Floating rivers of water are flowing in and around the temple's massive pillars. Summon Poseidon by simply attacking, but understand, he is a true god and has godly stats. You will not survive.

rooms.title: Underwater Silver Chest
rooms.description: The ocean floor smooths out here and in the smoothest area you see a silver chest. The ocean walls rise up here in all directions. The only exit you see is back northeast.

rooms.title: By a School of Jellyfish
rooms.description: A mix of red, blue and silver jellyfish bob up and down in the chilly water here.

rooms.title: Deep Under the Ocean
rooms.description: You are very deep under the ocean. The ocean get's brighter and warmer to the northeast. You see a pair of jellyfish swim to the south.

rooms.title: Surrounded by Coral
rooms.description: You are in the most colorful coral reef you have ever seen. Vibrant jellyfish, eels and crustaceans swim all around you. There are many other small critters scurrying about amongst the reef. There is a piece of coral here in the shape of a lever.

rooms.title: A Vast Underwater Landscape
rooms.description: The ocean floor stretches in all directions as far as your eyes can see. You see an opening above you where you can swim to the surface. The ocean floor dips down to the southwest and get's increasingly colorful to the south. You see a gold shimmer to the north as well as a school of sharks swim by. The wide ocean floor continues to the east. It appears someone left a sign here.

rooms.title: Underwater Gold Shrine
rooms.description: The gold chest here is centered on a solid gold platform with golden pillars at each corner. It's a lot of gold.

rooms.title: On the Ocean Floor
rooms.description: Assorted shells and rocks are all over the ocean floor here. You feel a current dragging you to the southeast. To the west you see the sun's light shining down into the ocean

rooms.title: In an Underwater Current
rooms.description: A strong current drags you to the east.

rooms.title: Giant Turtle Nest
rooms.description: You see baby turtles swimming all around. Some momma turtles pop their head out of the nest here. You see an opening up to the surface from here and what appears to be a ship to the southwest.

rooms.title: Sunken Ship
rooms.description: An ancient sunken ship lies on the ocean floor. Tattered pirate flags wave in the waters. Fish and sharks swim in and out of the ships cracks. There are many explorable cabins and exposed crevices inside the ship.

rooms.title: Mud Cave EXIT
rooms.description: This cave is completely covered in mud. You hear many many little crabs scurrying around you. Go east into the muddy tunnel or northeast to where you see most of the crabs coming from.

rooms.title: A Muddy Tunnel
rooms.description: You didn't think it was possible but this place is more muddy than the last.

rooms.title: Mud Crab Nest
rooms.description: The crabs never stop flowing out the walls!

rooms.title: An Underwater Alcove
rooms.description: Sparse patches of glowing coral pop out of the dark ocean floor. Impressive looking statues frame a large door made out of coral to the east.

rooms.title: Underwater Flower Patch
rooms.description: A bright yellow flower patch grows on the ocean floor here. You see white and gold fish swim in and out of the flowers.

rooms.title: Shark Infested Water
rooms.description: Little fish are scared to swim here due to the many aggressive sharks hunting. You see all sorts of larger fish, sharks and even giant squids swimming in and out of the shadows. Go west to continue through the shark infested water or head back southeast to return to a slightly safer part of the ocean.

rooms.title: Great White Gauntlet
rooms.description: You see only sharks swimming here, no other fish can survive. You can't even count the number of great whites circling you. You hear a low rumble and then a high pitched scream come from the northwest. Go east to escape this very dangerous area.

rooms.title: Secret Underwater Cave
rooms.description: Fancy jewels and shiny stones jut out of the rocks here. There is plenty of random junk scattered around the ocean floor that you can search through. There is also a glowing green pillar here that you can rest at. After you are done exploring all you can do is return to the surface.

rooms.title: Underwater Cavern
rooms.description: The cavern is dim and shadowy, with jagged rocks on most surfaces. Stalagmites and stalactites jut from the ceiling and floor.

rooms.title: The Kraken
rooms.description: You are in the lair of the Kraken. This unique beast attacks by launching multiple spiked projectiles in your direction while having the ability to heal itself and dodge your attacks. The kraken drops some great loot though, due to all the previous explorers and equipment it has consumed throughout the eons.

rooms.title: Stone Path Bridge
rooms.description: A chilly stream flows west to east below your feet. You see many large dark trees to the northeast. Over the bridge to the north you see a Ranger Outpost. Back to the south you see the forest path that leads all the way to Red Town.

rooms.title: Dark Forest Outpost | Ranger Guard
rooms.description: A Ranger Outpost is set up here as a deterrent to would be criminals and thieves. Head west to follow the path to the Stone Mountains or south to reach the Forest and Red Town.

rooms.title: Stone Path by the Outpost
rooms.description: On a rocky stone path between the Highway Mountain Toll and the Ranger Guard Outpost. Watch out for highwaymen.

rooms.title: Highway Toll | Mountain Gate
rooms.description:
A mean looking Highwayman stands guard at the Toll to the Stone Mountain Map. He’s looking to shake you down, don’t let that happen.

"Pay up or go back to where you came from!" -Highwayman

rooms.title: Dark Forest Clearing
rooms.description: You enter the Dark Forest and immediately notice the trees are much larger and the leaves much darker. You hear grunting and clanging coming from the hill to the north. To the northeast lies a massive stone door. Follow the path northwest through the clearing to get to the rest of the Dark Forest.

rooms.title: Dark Elf | Tree Hut
rooms.description:
You come across a finely crafted tree hut. The interior is warm and spacious. Impressive wood and stone tools are hanging on the walls, as well as framed paintings. A dark elf sits in a carved rocking chair sipping tea. He has several quests available for the enthusiastic adventurer. Make yourself at home and grab a cup of tea.

Drinking tea will increase your health and mana regeneration.

rooms.title: Dark Forest Teleport
rooms.description: A gold pillar stands in the center of a murky pool here. The pillar glows a soft orange and appears to be carved with odd symbols. The trees tower above you, so lush and dense that very little light reaches the ground. To the southeast you see a Tree Hut and to the north you see a faint golden glow coming from the darkness. There is an oak sign here with an iron axe leaning against it.

rooms.title: Dark Path
rooms.description: You’re on a path through the forest. It’s getting dark. To the west lies the Dark Forest Teleport. To the northeast you hear many strange screeching and howling sounds.

rooms.title: Dark Grove
rooms.description: A small, unique group of darkgreen trees grows here. You are surrounded by the dark forest in all directions. You feel like you might be lost here, but you are not.

rooms.title: Bloody Path
rooms.description: Damn. Things just got bloody. The red splattered path turns west here up to the top of a hill where you hear grunting and clanging. Return northwest to the grove.

rooms.title: Champion's Camp
rooms.description: Only the strongest trolls make it to the top of the hill. Remain and they will try to smash your face in. You can attempt to search all the scattered equipment if you can withstand the beating.

rooms.title: Dark Forest Silver Chest
rooms.description: A vine covered silver chest sits between 2 massive trees here at the edge of a steep ledge. You can jump north off the ledge, or return southwest through the open stone doors.

rooms.title: Dark Forest Gold Chest
rooms.description: Surrounded by thorny bushes this gold chest sits on a wide stump. There are large trees all around you, especially to the north. To the northwest you see an iron fence and an open gate.

rooms.title: Lost in the Trees
rooms.description: You appear to be lost. Trees tower around you in all directions.

rooms.title: Ranger's Guild
rooms.description: A wooden ladder ascends up the side of an enormous tree here. Up in the tree tops you see many wooden structures. Every now and then you see a ranger quickly climb up or down the tree.

rooms.title: Ranger’s Guild Lobby
rooms.description:
The Ranger’s Lobby is quite cozy. Rest at the burning fire or exchange some exciting adventure stories with your fellow Rangers.

N - Ranger Quests E - Silver Shaman S - Ranger Skills/Spells W - Ranger Shop

rooms.title: Lego's Quests
rooms.description: Young Ranger Lego is just chillin here re-stringing his bow and crafting some arrows. He has 3 quests for you to complete.

rooms.title: Silver Shaman | Silver Aura
rooms.description: The Silver Shaman can be seen levitating in the corner of this fancy room.

rooms.title: Ranger Skills & Spells
rooms.description: Only the most skilled guild members are here to distill their knowledge of the bow.

rooms.title: Ranger Shop
rooms.description: Welcome to the Ranger’s Guild Shop. Guild Merchant Flynn has some great weapons, armor and ammo for sale. The Guild’s Main Lobby is to the east. Lego is offering quests to the northeast and you can learn some great new skills to the southeast. Welcome Ranger.

rooms.title: Dark Keep Courtyard
rooms.description: This fenced in courtyard is dark and creepy. There are gruesome statues and twisted stone paths all around. You see the Dark Keep looming in the fog to the west.

rooms.title: Dark Keep Main Hall
rooms.description: You are in the main gathering hall of the Dark Keep. Paths go to the west and south. There is a solid steel door to the southwest.

rooms.title: Dark Keep Storeroom
rooms.description: You can rummage through this dusty storeroom. Beware of evil beasts though. There is a lever on the wall here.

rooms.title: Dark Keep Burial Chamber
rooms.description: There are many stone coffins in this room. Most are closed, but some are open. There is a lever on the wall here.

rooms.title: Dark Stairwell
rooms.description: A winding stone stairwell makes it’s way up the keep here. Beware the stairwell guardian, a beast made completely of stone.

rooms.title: Top of the Stairwell
rooms.description: You’ve made it to the top of the Keep. A massive ornate door stands to your northeast.

rooms.title: Dark Keep Barracks
rooms.description: All sorts of elite weapons and armor are stored in this room. Flip the switch or search through the rows of equipment.

rooms.title: Paladin Altar
rooms.description: The most holy of site’s for the disciplined paladins who guard the prince’s throne room. They will not allow you to desecrate it with your demonic presence any further.

rooms.title: Dark Throne
rooms.description: A crown sits atop an impressive steel throne. This giant throne room has the largest windows in the keep. Glancing to the east you see the magnificent Dark Forest. The trees continue to tower much higher than you already are. To the north you see a light greenish pillar of light. Beyond that you think you see an even Darker Forest, but that’s for another time. Right now there’s a crown.

rooms.title: Dark Thicket
rooms.description: You are surrounded by dense thicket. A solid gold gate blocks the way to the north.

rooms.title: Dark Twisted Path
rooms.description: The path gets really dark here and has many sharp twists and turns. Go east to head further into the forest or northwest to go back into the thicket.

rooms.title: By a Fallen Tree
rooms.description: A giant tree has fallen here. You have to navigate around the massive trunk and through many twisted branches. The path continues to the east.

rooms.title: Thorny Path
rooms.description: The path gets all twisty again here. Large thorny bushes are scattered all over. be careful or you’ll get stuck.

rooms.title: Dark Forest Troll Nest
rooms.description: You are in the heart of the Dark Forest where the magical Troll Queen guards the nest. There is an opening in the trees to the northwest and northeast. Go southeast to return to the path.

rooms.title: Empty Arena
rooms.description: You stand in an empty arena surrounded by tall trees that block out most of the sunlight. The arena floor is made of ancient, worn-down stone that has been overgrown with moss and ivy. Despite its abandoned state, there is still a sense of foreboding and danger in the air, as if the arena is waiting for its next battle to begin.

rooms.title: Troll King
rooms.description:
You are in the deepest and darkest part of the forest. It is dominated by the Troll King.

The King doesn’t have particularly high health or impressive stats but attacks with such vicious blows you can be torn to shreds in seconds if you’re not careful.

rooms.title: Top of the Despair
rooms.description: You get an uneasy feeling when you lean into the darkness below

rooms.title: Test of Light | Forest Princess
rooms.description: The beautiful forest princess is here. Battle her if you wish to be tested, or rest and feel great.

rooms.title: Mountain Path by the Dark Forest
rooms.description: The stone path continues west up the mountain. The path east will take you back to the forest. To the northwest you see a large patch of spruce trees growing on the mountain side.

rooms.title: Mountain Path
rooms.description: The most generic mountain path you can think of.

rooms.title: Wooded Mountain Path
rooms.description: There are a few trees lining the mountain path here. You see many more trees to the east. You hear a faint noise come from the west.

rooms.title: Mountain Alcove
rooms.description: You are inside a snowy alcove in the mountains. A bubbling stream travels east. You see a faint silver structure far to the west and to the northeast you see some tall trees.

rooms.title: Snowy Mountain Clearing
rooms.description: The chilly air gets warmer here in this large clearing. Mountains surround you in all directions. There is a sign here.

rooms.title: Abandoned Campsite & Lift
rooms.description: A functioning lift is all that remains in this desolate campsite. Talk to Merl the lift operator if you want to take it. You see a river flowing to the east and a shiny tower off in the distance to the west.

rooms.title: Stone Mountain Base Camp
rooms.description: There are several tents set up here by explorers preparing for their next adventure. A big camp fire burns here. To the north you see the Blue Guard Outpost. Take the lift south to get back to the Grassy Field.

rooms.title: Blue Guard Mountain Outpost
rooms.description: A sturdy outpost made out of stone and wood stands here. Occupied by the Blue Guard, they keep this area safe. You can reach Star City by going west and more mountains by going east. Talk to Hector the Blue Guard Captain for some quests.

rooms.title: Chilly Pete Mountain Cabin
rooms.description: Chilly Pete has a nice cabin set up here in the Mountains. You're surprised at how chilly it is even though there’s a fire burning. There is some tea available for adventurers passing through.

rooms.title: Master Trainer Master Skills
rooms.description: In the master's courtyard, you find yourself standing among marble pillars. In the center, a hooded man is floating off the ground. He is able to impart valuable skills without uttering a single word. To the west, you see the Gates to Star City, and to the east lies the Blue Guard Outpost.

rooms.title: Star City Blue Gate
rooms.description: You stand at the main gate to the city. It is an elaborate shiny structure, consisting of many moving pieces all clicking and popping in complex synchronization. Massive stone walls travel far to the north and south. Standing tall by the gate is Rigel the Knight.

rooms.title: In the Mountains Surrounded by Trees
rooms.description: Now we’re talking. It’s a lumberjack’s dream. You’re surrounded by massive trees in all directions.

rooms.title: Foggy Mountain Path
rooms.description: The dense fog makes it difficult to see where the path is going.

rooms.title: Icy Mountain Path
rooms.description: The mountain path is dangerously slippery here. Proceed with caution.

rooms.title: Bottom of a Ledge
rooms.description: You are in cold, dank pit. The only way out is to crawl up the south ledge.

rooms.title: Cathedral Graveyard
rooms.description: You are lost in a gloomy graveyard. You might find your way out, but probably not.

rooms.title: Stone Mountain Peak
rooms.description: You stand atop of the highest mountain peak. The largest giants wander around at this altitude. Stay frosty.

rooms.title: Deserted Mountain Campsite
rooms.description: The remains of a camp and fire are here. To the west you see a stone bridge and to the northeast the path continues to the cathedral.

rooms.title: Mountain Bridge
rooms.description: You walk on a stone bridge spanning over a large chasm below. The air here is frigid and brisk. You see a broken sign on the ground reading “Do not try to cross! Beware the Gatekeeper!”

rooms.title: Dragon’s Ledge
rooms.description: You stand at the edge of a mountain cliff overlooking the chasms below. To the northwest there is a vast expanse of unexplored mountains shining in the light. To the east is the stone bridge.

rooms.title: Cathedral Courtyard
rooms.description: Beware the gargoyle statues in this courtyard, for most of them are not statues. There is a gold chest placed in the center of a circular stone path. Go east to enter the cathedral, or southwest to return to the mountains.

rooms.title: Cathedral Nave
rooms.description: You stand in the largest and most decorated room of the cathedral. Pillars and walls with intricate sculptures frame out ancient paintings and ornate tapestries. The is a carved marble fount here filled with holy water. There are many dark corners and shadows to be weary of. Head west to leave the cathedral or east to get to the main altar.

rooms.title: Cathedral Altar
rooms.description: Marble stairs lead up to an altar decorated with rare stones and gems. Candles burn on every surface of the altar as well as the walls around you. The uneasy feeling in this room is almost unbearable.

rooms.title: Silver Temple
rooms.description: A simple glimmering tower stands here will a large arena before its entrance. Proud silver laden champions stand patiently around the arena ready to test those ready.

rooms.title: Camp Hero
rooms.description: Now this is a proper camp for a proper hero. There is a breathtaking view of Star City to the west. There are many areas to sit and mingle here and some food and supplies to grab. Rest at the fountain and feel fantastic.

rooms.title: Swamp Path near the Rocky Flats
rooms.description: A swampy path

rooms.title: Arcturus - Star City Wizard
rooms.description: A swampy path

rooms.title: Junk Collector
rooms.description: A grimy junk collector has a broken down shop set up here. Instead of items to sell though, he wants to buy your junk.

rooms.title: Swamp Path near the Ocean
rooms.description: A swampy path

rooms.title: Awesome Weapons
rooms.description: A swampy path

rooms.title: Mage Ultima
rooms.description: A swampy path

rooms.title: Quest Rewards
rooms.description: A swampy path

rooms.title: The Despair
rooms.description: Go up to exit
